title: Suiratcal
body:
The Suiratcal is a tree found in The Void Grove Biome, in the Island in the middle of the place. To get to the tree, you have to drive or walk across narrow bridge-like rocks.

It is recommended but not required to bring a Shadow Etcher as it deals 2x damage to the Suiratcal.

The Lunar Staff, or the Grabbiest Grabber is recommended as the tree is typically on the edge and will fall into the void when cut down.

it was, nerfed from $207.70/stud planked to near $135.7/stud planked. This is slightly less than the Snow Tree, which is far easier to obtain, however Suiratcal is still much better if you manage to get enough, due to its sheer width.

It takes roughly 5-8 minutes for the Suiratcal to respawn however if you leave the stump from a previous tree there it will never respawn until the stumps gone.

Fun facts:

1. The box variant of the Freyliner Transporter can in fact traverse the bridges to the Suiratcal tree, and fit under the arches, allowing you to get around 2.5 trees, or just 1 if its mutated to be large.

2. if you want to grind and not fail try magma caves as if you cut and sand 1 tree it is very simple to move and you can have a better time grinding
